name: Haphazard Wood Pile

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

stealth.details: (trained) to notice how the pile might fall on a person disabling it; DC 0 to see the pile.

disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained), DC 17 Crafting check (trained), or DC 17 Engineering-lore check (trained) to figure out how to safely dismantle the pile without it collapsing on anyone.

items.name: Collapse Inward
items.text:
Trigger Any of the four revelers within the hazard perform any action with the Move trait

---
Effect The pile collapses onto the four revelers, dealing 1d6+5 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save) to each of them. All four also take 1d6 persistent,bludgeoning damage until they're pulled from the rubble with a DC 17 Athletics check check or can escape dc=17.

items.name: Collapse Outward
items.text:
Trigger An attempt to disable the hazard from outside critically fails, or someone attempts to clamber into the pile of lumber

---
Effect The pile collapses outward, inflicting 1d6+5 bludgeoning damage to the four revelers (DC 15 basic Reflex save save), and 2d6+5 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save) to all creatures in a 10-foot area surrounding the central 10-foot-square where the revelers were trapped.

text: Beams of heavy and sharp wood rest against one another to form a precariously balanced cage tied to several trip lines and tension-bearing dowels.
